g.text: SWITCHES: each remote UP / DOWN / SEL closes to 3V3. PTT closes to GND.

g.desc: SWITCHES: each remote UP / DOWN / SEL closes to 3V3. PTT closes to GND.

g.text: GPIO mapping is fixed. All switches, display, speaker and haptic driver are OFF BOARD.

g.desc: GPIO mapping is fixed. All switches, display, speaker and haptic driver are OFF BOARD.

g.text: U1: USB at top; Sense camera + PDM stay on module. SD unused; GPIO21 held HIGH.

g.desc: U1: USB at top; Sense camera + PDM stay on module. SD unused; GPIO21 held HIGH.

g.text: XIAO underside BAT/USB/debug pads intentionally NOT contacted. Do not parallel chargers.

g.text: POWER: BAT+ is protected battery OUT+ for sensing. 5V is isolated boost/USB VUSB.

g.text: D2/GPIO3 is a strap: off-board 1k -> C1815 base. No pull-up on hub.

g.text: Ladder: idle 0V; SEL 1.32V; DOWN 2.24V; UP 3.3V. BAT divider = 2.0.
